# Proverbs 8 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Can't you hear Wisdom calling? Isn't Understanding raising her voice?

**2** She stands at the highest point along the road, right where the paths cross.

**3** She positions herself at the city gates, at every entrance, and shouts:

**4** "I'm calling out to every one of you — to every human being alive.

**5** You who are naive — learn to be sharp! You who are foolish — get some sense!

**6** Listen — what I'm about to say matters. Every word from my lips is honest.

**7** My mouth speaks only truth; my lips refuse to say anything wicked.

**8** Every word I speak is just and fair. There's nothing twisted or crooked in anything I say.

**9** They're perfectly clear to anyone who understands, and right to anyone who has found knowledge.

**10** Choose what I teach over silver. Choose knowledge over the finest gold.

**11** Because wisdom is worth more than rubies — nothing you could ever want comes close.

**12** I am Wisdom, and I live alongside good judgment. I've discovered knowledge and careful thinking.

**13** To respect the LORD means to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, corrupt behavior, and dishonest speech.

**14** Good advice comes from me, and real insight. Understanding is mine, and so is power.

**15** Through me, kings lead well, and rulers make fair laws.

**16** Through me, leaders govern, and every just decision-maker does their work.

**17** I love those who love me, and anyone who searches for me will find me.

**18** With me come wealth and honor — lasting prosperity and right standing.

**19** What I produce is worth more than gold — more than the purest gold — and what I yield beats the finest silver.

**20** I walk the road of doing right, right down the middle of the path of justice,

**21** Giving real wealth to those who love me and filling up everything they have.

**22** The LORD brought me into being at the very start of His work — before anything else He made.

**23** I was formed ages ago, at the very beginning, before the world existed.

**24** Before the oceans existed, I was born — before there were springs pouring out water.

**25** Before the mountains were set in place, before there were hills, I came into being,

**26** Before He made the earth or the fields, before the first handful of dust existed.

**27** When He set the sky in place, I was right there. When He drew the horizon over the face of the deep,

**28** When He locked the clouds in place above, when He secured the underground springs,

**29** When He set the boundaries for the sea so the water would never cross the line He drew, when He laid out the earth's foundations —

**30** I was right there beside Him, working alongside Him like a master craftsman. Every single day I was His joy, celebrating in His presence constantly,

**31** Celebrating over the world He made, absolutely delighted by the human race.

**32** So now, my children — listen to me. How fortunate are those who follow my ways!

**33** Pay attention to what I teach and become wise. Don't brush it aside.

**34** How fortunate is the person who listens to me — arriving early at my doors day after day, standing at my entrance, ready and waiting.

**35** Because whoever finds me finds life itself, and receives the LORD's full approval.

**36** But whoever rejects me is choosing self-destruction. Everyone who hates me is in love with death."

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **8:22-31**: This is arguably the most important passage in the entire book. Wisdom claims to have been there before anything was made — before oceans, before mountains, before dust. She's not just a concept; she's a person at God's side.

- **8:30-31**: The image of Wisdom 'playing' at creation is stunning — it suggests that joy and delight are built into the foundation of reality. The universe was made in celebration.

- **8:35-36**: The stakes couldn't be clearer: finding Wisdom = finding life. Rejecting Wisdom = choosing death. There's no middle ground.

— PNEUMA
